analysis.insight_summary: A user faced missing text in projects opened with [product_name] [version_no], while the same projects showed text normally in an earlier version. Other forum members reported no issues with the same version on different systems, pointing toward a problem specific to the user's environment or installation. The user resolved the issue by reinstalling the software, indicating it was a localized installation issue rather than a product-wide bug.
